title: Founding Paytm as the mobile-first payment utility
statement: After selling One97's earlier businesses, Sharma committed the company to a mobile wallet and payments platform, riding the smartphone wave.
outcome: Paytm became India's dominant wallet, the demonetization surge's biggest beneficiary, and built the merchant QR network that digitized small commerce.

title: The Ant monetization and Paytm's ill-timed IPO
statement: Paytm's $2.5 billion IPO — India's largest at the time — priced at the peak of the fintech window; Sharma personally monetized over $100 million in the offering.
outcome: The stock fell roughly 75% from its IPO price within a year as profitability remained distant, becoming the emblem of the Indian IPO bubble of 2021.

title: The RBI banking-partner shutdown
statement: The Reserve Bank barred Paytm Payments Bank from accepting new deposits after persistent compliance failures, effectively shutting the banking core of Sharma's empire.
outcome: Paytm survived by migrating merchants and users to partner-bank rails, refocusing on lending and distribution; the episode is the defining case of Indian fintech's regulatory reckoning.
